<h3 id="3复制代码测试">3.复制代码测试</h3>
<p><strong>为了方便调试, 我们先把运行模式由 InteractiveAuto 改为 InteractiveServer</strong></p>
<p>打开 App.razor 编辑 两行 @rendermode="InteractiveAuto" 改为 @rendermode="InteractiveServer"</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1980213/202510/1980213-20251003172226393-1113847130.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="4不出意外-代码出现了意外">4.不出意外, 代码出现了意外</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1980213/202510/1980213-20251003172421799-857682315.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>无脑使用AI修复一下</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1980213/202510/1980213-20251003172526807-545332831.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>结果发现不是这个问题. 是逻辑代码 @onclick="() =&gt; PlacePiece(x, y)" 问题. 原因是PlacePiece闭包捕获的 x、y 是当前循环的值</p>
<p>既然人工发现了问题, 我们继续提醒一下AI, 尝试修复</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1980213/202510/1980213-20251003174217922-1851565793.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>最后还是没修复成功, 手动处理一下</p>
<pre><code class="language-razor">@page "/"

&lt;PageTitle&gt;五子棋&lt;/PageTitle&gt;

&lt;h1&gt;五子棋游戏&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;div style="margin-bottom:10px;"&gt;
    当前玩家: &lt;b&gt;@(currentPlayer == 1 ? "黑子" : "白子")&lt;/b&gt;
    @if (winner != 0)
    {
        &lt;span style="color:red;margin-left:20px;"&gt;胜者: @(winner == 1 ? "黑子" : "白子")&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;button class="btn btn-primary" style="margin-left:20px;" @onclick="Restart"&gt;重新开始&lt;/button&gt;
    }
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;table style="border-collapse:collapse;"&gt;
    @for (int y = 0; y &lt; BoardSize; y++)
    {
        &lt;tr&gt;
            @for (int x = 0; x &lt; BoardSize; x++)
            {
                int _x = x;
                int _y = y;
                &lt;td style="width:32px;height:32px;border:1px solid #888;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle;cursor:pointer;background:@GetCellBg(x, y);"
                    @onclick="@(() =&gt; PlacePiece(_x, _y))"&gt;
                    @if (board[x, y] == 1)
                    {
                        &lt;span style="font-size:24px;color:black;"&gt;●&lt;/span&gt;
                    }
                    else if (board[x, y] == 2)
                    {
                        &lt;span style="font-size:24px;color:#eee;text-shadow:0 0 2px #888;"&gt;●&lt;/span&gt;
                    }
                &lt;/td&gt;
            }
        &lt;/tr&gt;
    }
&lt;/table&gt;

@code {
    const int BoardSize = 15;
    int[,] board = new int[BoardSize, BoardSize];
    int currentPlayer = 1; // 1: 黑子, 2: 白子
    int winner = 0;

    void PlacePiece(int x, int y)
    {
        // 修复：增加边界检查，防止越界
        if (x &lt; 0 || x &gt;= BoardSize || y &lt; 0 || y &gt;= BoardSize)
            return;
        if (winner != 0 || board[x, y] != 0)
            return;

        board[x, y] = currentPlayer;
        if (CheckWin(x, y, currentPlayer))
        {
            winner = currentPlayer;
        }
        else
        {
            currentPlayer = 3 - currentPlayer; // 切换玩家
        }
    }

    bool CheckWin(int x, int y, int player)
    {
        int[][] directions = new int[][]
        {
            new int[]{1,0}, // 横
            new int[]{0,1}, // 竖
            new int[]{1,1}, // 斜
            new int[]{1,-1} // 反斜
        };
        foreach (var dir in directions)
        {
            int count = 1;
            count += CountDirection(x, y, dir[0], dir[1], player);
            count += CountDirection(x, y, -dir[0], -dir[1], player);
            if (count &gt;= 5)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    int CountDirection(int x, int y, int dx, int dy, int player)
    {
        int count = 0;
        for (int step = 1; step &lt; 5; step++)
        {
            int nx = x + dx * step;
            int ny = y + dy * step;
            if (nx &lt; 0 || nx &gt;= BoardSize || ny &lt; 0 || ny &gt;= BoardSize)
                break;
            if (board[nx, ny] == player)
                count++;
            else
                break;
        }
        return count;
    }

    void Restart()
    {
        board = new int[BoardSize, BoardSize];
        currentPlayer = 1;
        winner = 0;
    }

    string GetCellBg(int x, int y)
    {
        return (x + y) % 2 == 0 ? "#f9d77e" : "#eac066";
    }
}

</code></pre>
<p><strong>说明：</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>添加 int _x = x; int _y = y; 确保闭包捕获的 <code>_x</code>、<code>_y</code> 是当前循环的值，避免 Blazor 渲染时闭包变量引用错误。</li>
<li>在 <code>PlacePiece</code> 方法开头增加边界检查，防止非法坐标导致数组越界异常。</li>
</ol>
<p>这样可以彻底修复 <code>PlacePiece</code> 拿到的变量不正确和越界的问题。</p>
<h3 id="5-运行效果">5. 运行效果</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1980213/202510/1980213-20251003175448439-796392876.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="6-加入显示当前玩家的得分功能">6. 加入显示当前玩家的得分功能</h3>
<p>你可以为每个玩家增加一个分数变量，每次有玩家获胜时将其分数加一，并在界面上显示。下面是具体实现方法：</p>
<ol>
<li>在 <code>@code</code> 区域添加分数字段：</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">int blackScore = 0;
int whiteScore = 0;
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>在玩家获胜时更新分数：</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">void PlacePiece(int x, int y)
{
    if (x &lt; 0 || x &gt;= BoardSize || y &lt; 0 || y &gt;= BoardSize)
        return;
    if (winner != 0 || board[x, y] != 0)
        return;

    board[x, y] = currentPlayer;
    if (CheckWin(x, y, currentPlayer))
    {
        winner = currentPlayer;
        if (winner == 1)
            blackScore++;
        else if (winner == 2)
            whiteScore++;
    }
    else
    {
        currentPlayer = 3 - currentPlayer; // 切换玩家
    }
}
</code></pre>
<ol start="3">
<li>在页面上显示分数（比如在标题下方）：</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-razor">&lt;div style="margin-bottom:10px;"&gt;
    当前玩家: &lt;b&gt;@(currentPlayer == 1 ? "黑子" : "白子")&lt;/b&gt;
    &lt;span style="margin-left:20px;"&gt;黑子得分: &lt;b&gt;@blackScore&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
    &lt;span style="margin-left:20px;"&gt;白子得分: &lt;b&gt;@whiteScore&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
    @if (winner != 0)
    {
        &lt;span style="color:red;margin-left:20px;"&gt;胜者: @(winner == 1 ? "黑子" : "白子")&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;button class="btn btn-primary" style="margin-left:20px;" @onclick="Restart"&gt;重新开始&lt;/button&gt;
    }
&lt;/div&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>这样每次有玩家获胜时，分数都会自动更新并显示在页面上。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1980213/202510/1980213-20251003182149265-1411643153.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="7-加入重置得分功能">7. 加入重置得分功能</h3>
<p>你可以在 <code>Restart</code> 方法中增加对分数的重置，或者单独添加一个“重置得分”按钮和方法。推荐做法如下：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>添加重置得分方法：</strong></li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">void ResetScore()
{
    blackScore = 0;
    whiteScore = 0;
}
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li><strong>在页面上添加按钮：</strong></li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-razor">&lt;button class="btn btn-danger" style="margin-left:20px;" @onclick="ResetScore"&gt;重置得分&lt;/button&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>建议将此按钮放在分数显示附近，例如：</p>
<pre><code class="language-razor">&lt;div style="margin-bottom:10px;"&gt;
    当前玩家: &lt;b&gt;@(currentPlayer == 1 ? "黑子" : "白子")&lt;/b&gt;
    &lt;span style="margin-left:20px;"&gt;黑子得分: &lt;b&gt;@blackScore&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
    &lt;span style="margin-left:20px;"&gt;白子得分: &lt;b&gt;@whiteScore&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
    &lt;button class="btn btn-danger" style="margin-left:20px;" @onclick="ResetScore"&gt;重置得分&lt;/button&gt;
    @if (winner != 0)
    {
        &lt;span style="color:red;margin-left:20px;"&gt;胜者: @(winner == 1 ? "黑子" : "白子")&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;button class="btn btn-primary" style="margin-left:20px;" @onclick="Restart"&gt;重新开始&lt;/button&gt;
    }
&lt;/div&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>这样点击“重置得分”按钮即可将分数清零。</p>
<h3 id="8-在这个五子棋游戏中添加-ai-对手功能">8. 在这个五子棋游戏中添加 AI 对手功能</h3>
<p>在你的 Blazor 五子棋游戏中添加 AI 对手功能，常见做法是让一方（如白子）由 AI 自动落子。实现思路如下：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>判断当前玩家是否为 AI</strong>：如 currentPlayer == 2 时，自动调用 AI 落子逻辑。</li>
<li><strong>实现 AI 落子算法</strong>：可以先用简单的随机落子，后续可扩展为更智能的算法。</li>
<li><strong>在玩家落子后自动触发 AI 落子</strong>：用 <code>StateHasChanged()</code> 刷新界面，必要时用 <code>await Task.Delay()</code> 增加落子延迟。</li>
</ol>
<p>下面是具体实现方法（以白子为 AI）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-razor">@page "/"

&lt;PageTitle&gt;五子棋&lt;/PageTitle&gt;

&lt;h1&gt;五子棋游戏&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;div style="margin-bottom:10px;"&gt;
    当前玩家: &lt;b&gt;@(currentPlayer == 1 ? "黑子" : "白子(电脑)")&lt;/b&gt;
    &lt;span style="margin-left:20px;"&gt;黑子得分: &lt;b&gt;@blackScore&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
    &lt;span style="margin-left:20px;"&gt;白子得分: &lt;b&gt;@whiteScore&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
    &lt;button class="btn btn-danger" style="margin-left:20px;" @onclick="ResetScore"&gt;重置得分&lt;/button&gt;
    @if (winner != 0)
    {
        &lt;span style="color:red;margin-left:20px;"&gt;胜者: @(winner == 1 ? "黑子" : "白子(电脑)")&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;button class="btn btn-primary" style="margin-left:20px;" @onclick="Restart"&gt;重新开始&lt;/button&gt;
    }
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;table style="border-collapse:collapse;"&gt;
    @for (int y = 0; y &lt; BoardSize; y++)
    {
        &lt;tr&gt;
            @for (int x = 0; x &lt; BoardSize; x++)
            {
                int _x = x;
                int _y = y;
                &lt;td style="width:32px;height:32px;border:1px solid #888;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle;cursor:pointer;background:@GetCellBg(x, y);"
                    @onclick="@(() =&gt; PlacePiece(_x, _y))"&gt;
                    @if (board[x, y] == 1)
                    {
                        &lt;span style="font-size:24px;color:black;"&gt;●&lt;/span&gt;
                    }
                    else if (board[x, y] == 2)
                    {
                        &lt;span style="font-size:24px;color:#eee;text-shadow:0 0 2px #888;"&gt;●&lt;/span&gt;
                    }
                &lt;/td&gt;
            }
        &lt;/tr&gt;
    }
&lt;/table&gt;

@code {
    const int BoardSize = 15;
    int[,] board = new int[BoardSize, BoardSize];
    int currentPlayer = 1; // 1: 黑子, 2: 白子(电脑)
    int winner = 0;
    int blackScore = 0;
    int whiteScore = 0;
    Random rand = new();

    void PlacePiece(int x, int y)
    {
        if (winner != 0 || board[x, y] != 0 || currentPlayer == 2)
            return;

        board[x, y] = currentPlayer;
        if (CheckWin(x, y, currentPlayer))
        {
            winner = currentPlayer;
            if (winner == 1)
                blackScore++;
            else if (winner == 2)
                whiteScore++;
        }
        else
        {
            currentPlayer = 2;
            StateHasChanged();
            _ = AITurnAsync();
        }
    }

    async Task AITurnAsync()
    {
        await Task.Delay(500); // AI 落子延迟
        if (winner != 0) return;

        // 简单随机落子
        var empty = new List&lt;(int x, int y)&gt;();
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; BoardSize; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j &lt; BoardSize; j++)
                if (board[i, j] == 0)
                    empty.Add((i, j));
        if (empty.Count == 0) return;

        var (aiX, aiY) = empty[rand.Next(empty.Count)];
        board[aiX, aiY] = 2;
        if (CheckWin(aiX, aiY, 2))
        {
            winner = 2;
            whiteScore++;
        }
        else
        {
            currentPlayer = 1;
        }
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    // 其余代码不变...
    bool CheckWin(int x, int y, int player)
    {
        int[][] directions = new int[][]
        {
            new int[]{1,0}, new int[]{0,1}, new int[]{1,1}, new int[]{1,-1}
        };
        foreach (var dir in directions)
        {
            int count = 1;
            count += CountDirection(x, y, dir[0], dir[1], player);
            count += CountDirection(x, y, -dir[0], -dir[1], player);
            if (count &gt;= 5)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    int CountDirection(int x, int y, int dx, int dy, int player)
    {
        int count = 0;
        for (int step = 1; step &lt; 5; step++)
        {
            int nx = x + dx * step;
            int ny = y + dy * step;
            if (nx &lt; 0 || nx &gt;= BoardSize || ny &lt; 0 || ny &gt;= BoardSize)
                break;
            if (board[nx, ny] == player)
                count++;
            else
                break;
        }
        return count;
    }

    void Restart()
    {
        board = new int[BoardSize, BoardSize];
        currentPlayer = 1;
        winner = 0;
    }

    void ResetScore()
    {
        blackScore = 0;
        whiteScore = 0;
    }

    string GetCellBg(int x, int y)
    {
        return (x + y) % 2 == 0 ? "#f9d77e" : "#eac066";
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>要点说明：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>玩家（黑子）落子后自动触发 AI（白子）落子。</li>
<li>AI 采用随机空位落子，简单易懂，后续可扩展为更智能算法。</li>
<li>若要让 AI 先手，只需将 <code>currentPlayer = 2</code> 并在 <code>OnInitialized</code> 或 <code>Restart</code> 时调用 <code>AITurnAsync()</code>。</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1980213/202510/1980213-20251003190458928-2111735356.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>用是能用了, 就是这个AI太傻了,继续优化一下</p>
<p>要优化五子棋 AI 的落子策略，可以采用“优先级评分法”来提升难度。基本思路如下：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>优先考虑能直接获胜的位置</strong>（如 AI 连成五子）。</li>
<li><strong>阻止玩家获胜</strong>（如玩家有四连，AI 必须堵住）。</li>
<li><strong>优先进攻</strong>（如自己有三连、二连）。</li>
<li><strong>其次防守</strong>（如玩家有三连、二连）。</li>
<li><strong>否则随机或选择评分最高的位置</strong>。</li>
</ol>
<p>下面是一个简单的评分法实现，AI 会优先选择能赢、能防守、能进攻的位置：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">async Task AITurnAsync()
{
    await Task.Delay(500);
    if (winner != 0) return;

    var (aiX, aiY) = FindBestMove();
    board[aiX, aiY] = 2;
    if (CheckWin(aiX, aiY, 2))
    {
        winner = 2;
        whiteScore++;
    }
    else
    {
        currentPlayer = 1;
    }
    StateHasChanged();
}

// 简单评分法：优先赢棋、阻挡对方、进攻
(int, int) FindBestMove()
{
    int maxScore = int.MinValue;
    var bestMoves = new List&lt;(int x, int y)&gt;();
    for (int x = 0; x &lt; BoardSize; x++)
    {
        for (int y = 0; y &lt; BoardSize; y++)
        {
            if (board[x, y] != 0) continue;
            int score = EvaluatePoint(x, y, 2); // AI进攻
            score = Math.Max(score, EvaluatePoint(x, y, 1)); // 防守
            if (score &gt; maxScore)
            {
                maxScore = score;
                bestMoves.Clear();
                bestMoves.Add((x, y));
            }
            else if (score == maxScore)
            {
                bestMoves.Add((x, y));
            }
        }
    }
    // 多个最佳点时随机选一个
    return bestMoves[rand.Next(bestMoves.Count)];
}

// 评分函数：可根据实际需要调整权重
int EvaluatePoint(int x, int y, int player)
{
    int score = 0;
    int opponent = player == 1 ? 2 : 1;
    // 检查4连、3连、2连等
    foreach (var dir in new[] { (1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 1), (1, -1) })
    {
        int count = 1 + CountDirection(x, y, dir.Item1, dir.Item2, player)
                      + CountDirection(x, y, -dir.Item1, -dir.Item2, player);
        if (count &gt;= 5) score += 10000; // 直接获胜
        else if (count == 4) score += 1000;
        else if (count == 3) score += 100;
        else if (count == 2) score += 10;

        // 防守分数
        int oppCount = 1 + CountDirection(x, y, dir.Item1, dir.Item2, opponent)
                         + CountDirection(x, y, -dir.Item1, -dir.Item2, opponent);
        if (oppCount &gt;= 5) score += 9000; // 必须防守
        else if (oppCount == 4) score += 900;
        else if (oppCount == 3) score += 90;
        else if (oppCount == 2) score += 9;
    }
    return score;
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>集成方法：</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>替换你的 <code>AITurnAsync</code> 方法为上述实现。</li>
<li>在 <code>@code</code> 区域添加 <code>FindBestMove</code> 和 <code>EvaluatePoint</code> 方法。</li>
<li>可根据实际效果调整评分权重。</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>效果说明：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>AI 会优先选择能赢的位置，其次堵住玩家的四连，再考虑进攻和防守三连、二连。</li>
<li>这种评分法简单高效，能显著提升 AI 难度。</li>
<li>若需更高难度，可进一步实现“活三”、“活四”识别、双向评分、甚至 Minimax 算法。</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1980213/202510/1980213-20251003190707058-846681568.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="9-添加难度切换按钮">9. 添加难度切换按钮</h3>
<p>添加三个难度选择按钮以及切换人机按钮</p>
<p>下面是实现“三个难度选择按钮（简单、中等、困难）”和“人机/人人切换按钮”的完整方法。<br>
难度通过调整 AI 的评分权重实现，人机切换通过 <code>isHumanVsAI</code> 控制。请直接替换你的 <code>Home.razor</code> 文件内容：</p>
<pre><code class="language-razor">@page "/"

&lt;PageTitle&gt;五子棋&lt;/PageTitle&gt;

&lt;h1&gt;五子棋游戏&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;div style="margin-bottom:10px;"&gt;
    &lt;b&gt;难度：&lt;/b&gt;
    &lt;button class="btn btn-sm @(aiLevel==0?"btn-primary":"btn-outline-primary")" @onclick="() =&gt; SetAILevel(0)"&gt;简单&lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;button class="btn btn-sm @(aiLevel==1?"btn-primary":"btn-outline-primary")" @onclick="() =&gt; SetAILevel(1)"&gt;中等&lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;button class="btn btn-sm @(aiLevel==2?"btn-primary":"btn-outline-primary")" @onclick="() =&gt; SetAILevel(2)"&gt;困难&lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;span style="margin-left:20px;"&gt;
        &lt;b&gt;模式：&lt;/b&gt;
        &lt;button class="btn btn-sm @(isHumanVsAI?"btn-success":"btn-outline-success")" @onclick="ToggleMode"&gt;
            @(isHumanVsAI ? "人机对战" : "人人对战")
        &lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;div style="margin-bottom:10px;"&gt;
    当前玩家: &lt;b&gt;@(currentPlayer == 1 ? "黑子" : (isHumanVsAI ? "白子(电脑)" : "白子"))&lt;/b&gt;
    &lt;span style="margin-left:20px;"&gt;黑子得分: &lt;b&gt;@blackScore&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
    &lt;span style="margin-left:20px;"&gt;白子得分: &lt;b&gt;@whiteScore&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
    &lt;button class="btn btn-danger" style="margin-left:20px;" @onclick="ResetScore"&gt;重置得分&lt;/button&gt;
    @if (winner != 0)
    {
        &lt;span style="color:red;margin-left:20px;"&gt;胜者: @(winner == 1 ? "黑子" : (isHumanVsAI ? "白子(电脑)" : "白子"))&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;button class="btn btn-primary" style="margin-left:20px;" @onclick="Restart"&gt;重新开始&lt;/button&gt;
    }
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;table style="border-collapse:collapse;"&gt;
    @for (int y = 0; y &lt; BoardSize; y++)
    {
        &lt;tr&gt;
            @for (int x = 0; x &lt; BoardSize; x++)
            {
                int _x = x;
                int _y = y;
                &lt;td style="width:32px;height:32px;border:1px solid #888;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle;cursor:pointer;background:@GetCellBg(x, y);"
                    @onclick="@(() =&gt; PlacePiece(_x, _y))"&gt;
                    @if (board[x, y] == 1)
                    {
                        &lt;span style="font-size:24px;color:black;"&gt;●&lt;/span&gt;
                    }
                    else if (board[x, y] == 2)
                    {
                        &lt;span style="font-size:24px;color:#eee;text-shadow:0 0 2px #888;"&gt;●&lt;/span&gt;
                    }
                &lt;/td&gt;
            }
        &lt;/tr&gt;
    }
&lt;/table&gt;

@code {
    const int BoardSize = 15;
    int[,] board = new int[BoardSize, BoardSize];
    int currentPlayer = 1; // 1: 黑子, 2: 白子(电脑/玩家)
    int winner = 0;
    int blackScore = 0;
    int whiteScore = 0;
    Random rand = new();
    bool isHumanVsAI = true;
    int aiLevel = 1; // 0:简单 1:中等 2:困难

    void PlacePiece(int x, int y)
    {
        if (winner != 0 || board[x, y] != 0)
            return;

        // 人机模式下，只有当前为玩家时可落子
        if (isHumanVsAI &amp;&amp; currentPlayer == 2)
            return;

        board[x, y] = currentPlayer;
        if (CheckWin(x, y, currentPlayer))
        {
            winner = currentPlayer;
            if (winner == 1)
                blackScore++;
            else if (winner == 2)
                whiteScore++;
        }
        else
        {
            currentPlayer = 3 - currentPlayer;
            if (isHumanVsAI &amp;&amp; currentPlayer == 2 &amp;&amp; winner == 0)
            {
                StateHasChanged();
                _ = AITurnAsync();
            }
        }
    }

    async Task AITurnAsync()
    {
        await Task.Delay(500);
        if (winner != 0) return;

        var (aiX, aiY) = FindBestMove();
        board[aiX, aiY] = 2;
        if (CheckWin(aiX, aiY, 2))
        {
            winner = 2;
            whiteScore++;
        }
        else
        {
            currentPlayer = 1;
        }
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    (int, int) FindBestMove()
    {
        if (aiLevel == 0)
        {
            // 简单：随机落子
            var empty = new List&lt;(int x, int y)&gt;();
            for (int i = 0; i &lt; BoardSize; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j &lt; BoardSize; j++)
                    if (board[i, j] == 0)
                        empty.Add((i, j));
            return empty[rand.Next(empty.Count)];
        }
        else
        {
            // 中等/困难：评分法
            int maxScore = int.MinValue;
            var bestMoves = new List&lt;(int x, int y)&gt;();
            for (int x = 0; x &lt; BoardSize; x++)
            {
                for (int y = 0; y &lt; BoardSize; y++)
                {
                    if (board[x, y] != 0) continue;
                    int score = EvaluatePoint(x, y, 2);
                    score = Math.Max(score, EvaluatePoint(x, y, 1));
                    if (score &gt; maxScore)
                    {
                        maxScore = score;
                        bestMoves.Clear();
                        bestMoves.Add((x, y));
                    }
                    else if (score == maxScore)
                    {
                        bestMoves.Add((x, y));
                    }
                }
            }
            return bestMoves[rand.Next(bestMoves.Count)];
        }
    }

    int EvaluatePoint(int x, int y, int player)
    {
        int score = 0;
        int opponent = player == 1 ? 2 : 1;
        // 不同难度权重
        int[] winWeight = { 100, 10000, 10000 };
        int[] fourWeight = { 10, 1000, 3000 };
        int[] threeWeight = { 5, 100, 500 };
        int[] twoWeight = { 2, 10, 50 };
        int[] blockWinWeight = { 90, 9000, 9000 };
        int[] blockFourWeight = { 9, 900, 2500 };
        int[] blockThreeWeight = { 4, 90, 400 };
        int[] blockTwoWeight = { 1, 9, 40 };

        foreach (var dir in new[] { (1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 1), (1, -1) })
        {
            int count = 1 + CountDirection(x, y, dir.Item1, dir.Item2, player)
                          + CountDirection(x, y, -dir.Item1, -dir.Item2, player);
            if (count &gt;= 5) score += winWeight[aiLevel];
            else if (count == 4) score += fourWeight[aiLevel];
            else if (count == 3) score += threeWeight[aiLevel];
            else if (count == 2) score += twoWeight[aiLevel];

            int oppCount = 1 + CountDirection(x, y, dir.Item1, dir.Item2, opponent)
                             + CountDirection(x, y, -dir.Item1, -dir.Item2, opponent);
            if (oppCount &gt;= 5) score += blockWinWeight[aiLevel];
            else if (oppCount == 4) score += blockFourWeight[aiLevel];
            else if (oppCount == 3) score += blockThreeWeight[aiLevel];
            else if (oppCount == 2) score += blockTwoWeight[aiLevel];
        }
        return score;
    }

    bool CheckWin(int x, int y, int player)
    {
        int[][] directions = new int[][]
        {
            new int[]{1,0}, new int[]{0,1}, new int[]{1,1}, new int[]{1,-1}
        };
        foreach (var dir in directions)
        {
            int count = 1;
            count += CountDirection(x, y, dir[0], dir[1], player);
            count += CountDirection(x, y, -dir[0], -dir[1], player);
            if (count &gt;= 5)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    int CountDirection(int x, int y, int dx, int dy, int player)
    {
        int count = 0;
        for (int step = 1; step &lt; 5; step++)
        {
            int nx = x + dx * step;
            int ny = y + dy * step;
            if (nx &lt; 0 || nx &gt;= BoardSize || ny &lt; 0 || ny &gt;= BoardSize)
                break;
            if (board[nx, ny] == player)
                count++;
            else
                break;
        }
        return count;
    }

    void Restart()
    {
        board = new int[BoardSize, BoardSize];
        currentPlayer = 1;
        winner = 0;
        if (isHumanVsAI &amp;&amp; currentPlayer == 2)
        {
            _ = AITurnAsync();
        }
    }

    void ResetScore()
    {
        blackScore = 0;
        whiteScore = 0;
    }

    void SetAILevel(int level)
    {
        aiLevel = level;
        Restart();
    }

    void ToggleMode()
    {
        isHumanVsAI = !isHumanVsAI;
        Restart();
    }

    string GetCellBg(int x, int y)
    {
        return (x + y) % 2 == 0 ? "#f9d77e" : "#eac066";
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>说明：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>“简单”AI为随机落子，“中等/困难”AI为评分法，困难权重更高更难。</li>
<li>“人机对战”时白子为AI，“人人对战”时双方均为玩家。</li>
<li>切换难度或模式会自动重开棋局。</li>
<li>你可以根据需要调整权重数组以微调难度。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="10-最后贴上完整代码">10. 最后贴上完整代码</h3>
<pre><code class="language-razor">@page "/"

&lt;PageTitle&gt;五子棋&lt;/PageTitle&gt;

&lt;h1&gt;五子棋游戏&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;div style="margin-bottom:10px;"&gt;
    &lt;b&gt;难度：&lt;/b&gt;
    &lt;button class="btn btn-sm @(aiLevel==0?"btn-primary":"btn-outline-primary")" @onclick="() =&gt; SetAILevel(0)"&gt;简单&lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;button class="btn btn-sm @(aiLevel==1?"btn-primary":"btn-outline-primary")" @onclick="() =&gt; SetAILevel(1)"&gt;中等&lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;button class="btn btn-sm @(aiLevel==2?"btn-primary":"btn-outline-primary")" @onclick="() =&gt; SetAILevel(2)"&gt;困难&lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;span style="margin-left:20px;"&gt;
        &lt;b&gt;模式：&lt;/b&gt;
        &lt;button class="btn btn-sm @(isHumanVsAI?"btn-success":"btn-outline-success")" @onclick="ToggleMode"&gt;
            @(isHumanVsAI ? "人机对战" : "人人对战")
        &lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;div style="margin-bottom:10px;"&gt;
    当前玩家: &lt;b&gt;@(currentPlayer == 1 ? "黑子" : (isHumanVsAI ? "白子(电脑)" : "白子"))&lt;/b&gt;
    &lt;span style="margin-left:20px;"&gt;黑子得分: &lt;b&gt;@blackScore&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
    &lt;span style="margin-left:20px;"&gt;白子得分: &lt;b&gt;@whiteScore&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
    &lt;button class="btn btn-danger" style="margin-left:20px;" @onclick="ResetScore"&gt;重置得分&lt;/button&gt;
    @if (winner != 0)
    {
        &lt;span style="color:red;margin-left:20px;"&gt;胜者: @(winner == 1 ? "黑子" : (isHumanVsAI ? "白子(电脑)" : "白子"))&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;button class="btn btn-primary" style="margin-left:20px;" @onclick="Restart"&gt;重新开始&lt;/button&gt;
    }
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;table style="border-collapse:collapse;"&gt;
    @for (int y = 0; y &lt; BoardSize; y++)
    {
        &lt;tr&gt;
            @for (int x = 0; x &lt; BoardSize; x++)
            {
                int _x = x;
                int _y = y;
                &lt;td style="width:32px;height:32px;border:1px solid #888;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle;cursor:pointer;background:@GetCellBg(x, y);"
                    @onclick="@(() =&gt; PlacePiece(_x, _y))"&gt;
                    @if (board[x, y] == 1)
                    {
                        &lt;span style="font-size:24px;color:black;"&gt;●&lt;/span&gt;
                    }
                    else if (board[x, y] == 2)
                    {
                        &lt;span style="font-size:24px;color:#eee;text-shadow:0 0 2px #888;"&gt;●&lt;/span&gt;
                    }
                &lt;/td&gt;
            }
        &lt;/tr&gt;
    }
&lt;/table&gt;

@code {
    const int BoardSize = 15;
    int[,] board = new int[BoardSize, BoardSize];
    int currentPlayer = 1; // 1: 黑子, 2: 白子(电脑/玩家)
    int winner = 0;
    int blackScore = 0;
    int whiteScore = 0;
    Random rand = new();
    bool isHumanVsAI = true;
    int aiLevel = 1; // 0:简单 1:中等 2:困难

    void PlacePiece(int x, int y)
    {
        if (winner != 0 || board[x, y] != 0)
            return;

        // 人机模式下，只有当前为玩家时可落子
        if (isHumanVsAI &amp;&amp; currentPlayer == 2)
            return;

        board[x, y] = currentPlayer;
        if (CheckWin(x, y, currentPlayer))
        {
            winner = currentPlayer;
            if (winner == 1)
                blackScore++;
            else if (winner == 2)
                whiteScore++;
        }
        else
        {
            currentPlayer = 3 - currentPlayer;
            if (isHumanVsAI &amp;&amp; currentPlayer == 2 &amp;&amp; winner == 0)
            {
                StateHasChanged();
                _ = AITurnAsync();
            }
        }
    }

    async Task AITurnAsync()
    {
        await Task.Delay(500);
        if (winner != 0) return;

        var (aiX, aiY) = FindBestMove();
        board[aiX, aiY] = 2;
        if (CheckWin(aiX, aiY, 2))
        {
            winner = 2;
            whiteScore++;
        }
        else
        {
            currentPlayer = 1;
        }
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    (int, int) FindBestMove()
    {
        if (aiLevel == 0)
        {
            // 简单：随机落子
            var empty = new List&lt;(int x, int y)&gt;();
            for (int i = 0; i &lt; BoardSize; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j &lt; BoardSize; j++)
                    if (board[i, j] == 0)
                        empty.Add((i, j));
            return empty[rand.Next(empty.Count)];
        }
        else
        {
            // 中等/困难：评分法
            int maxScore = int.MinValue;
            var bestMoves = new List&lt;(int x, int y)&gt;();
            for (int x = 0; x &lt; BoardSize; x++)
            {
                for (int y = 0; y &lt; BoardSize; y++)
                {
                    if (board[x, y] != 0) continue;
                    int score = EvaluatePoint(x, y, 2);
                    score = Math.Max(score, EvaluatePoint(x, y, 1));
                    if (score &gt; maxScore)
                    {
                        maxScore = score;
                        bestMoves.Clear();
                        bestMoves.Add((x, y));
                    }
                    else if (score == maxScore)
                    {
                        bestMoves.Add((x, y));
                    }
                }
            }
            return bestMoves[rand.Next(bestMoves.Count)];
        }
    }

    int EvaluatePoint(int x, int y, int player)
    {
        int score = 0;
        int opponent = player == 1 ? 2 : 1;
        // 不同难度权重
        int[] winWeight = { 100, 10000, 10000 };
        int[] fourWeight = { 10, 1000, 3000 };
        int[] threeWeight = { 5, 100, 500 };
        int[] twoWeight = { 2, 10, 50 };
        int[] blockWinWeight = { 90, 9000, 9000 };
        int[] blockFourWeight = { 9, 900, 2500 };
        int[] blockThreeWeight = { 4, 90, 400 };
        int[] blockTwoWeight = { 1, 9, 40 };

        foreach (var dir in new[] { (1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 1), (1, -1) })
        {
            int count = 1 + CountDirection(x, y, dir.Item1, dir.Item2, player)
                          + CountDirection(x, y, -dir.Item1, -dir.Item2, player);
            if (count &gt;= 5) score += winWeight[aiLevel];
            else if (count == 4) score += fourWeight[aiLevel];
            else if (count == 3) score += threeWeight[aiLevel];
            else if (count == 2) score += twoWeight[aiLevel];

            int oppCount = 1 + CountDirection(x, y, dir.Item1, dir.Item2, opponent)
                             + CountDirection(x, y, -dir.Item1, -dir.Item2, opponent);
            if (oppCount &gt;= 5) score += blockWinWeight[aiLevel];
            else if (oppCount == 4) score += blockFourWeight[aiLevel];
            else if (oppCount == 3) score += blockThreeWeight[aiLevel];
            else if (oppCount == 2) score += blockTwoWeight[aiLevel];
        }
        return score;
    }

    bool CheckWin(int x, int y, int player)
    {
        int[][] directions = new int[][]
        {
            new int[]{1,0}, new int[]{0,1}, new int[]{1,1}, new int[]{1,-1}
        };
        foreach (var dir in directions)
        {
            int count = 1;
            count += CountDirection(x, y, dir[0], dir[1], player);
            count += CountDirection(x, y, -dir[0], -dir[1], player);
            if (count &gt;= 5)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    int CountDirection(int x, int y, int dx, int dy, int player)
    {
        int count = 0;
        for (int step = 1; step &lt; 5; step++)
        {
            int nx = x + dx * step;
            int ny = y + dy * step;
            if (nx &lt; 0 || nx &gt;= BoardSize || ny &lt; 0 || ny &gt;= BoardSize)
                break;
            if (board[nx, ny] == player)
                count++;
            else
                break;
        }
        return count;
    }

    void Restart()
    {
        board = new int[BoardSize, BoardSize];
        currentPlayer = 1;
        winner = 0;
        if (isHumanVsAI &amp;&amp; currentPlayer == 2)
        {
            _ = AITurnAsync();
        }
    }

    void ResetScore()
    {
        blackScore = 0;
        whiteScore = 0;
    }

    void SetAILevel(int level)
    {
        aiLevel = level;
        Restart();
    }

    void ToggleMode()
    {
        isHumanVsAI = !isHumanVsAI;
        Restart();
    }

    string GetCellBg(int x, int y)
    {
        return (x + y) % 2 == 0 ? "#f9d77e" : "#eac066";
    }
}

<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1980213/202510/1980213-20251003195901561-582465000.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>把运行模式改回来,Auto模式不占用服务器计算资源</strong></p>
<p>打开 App.razor 编辑 两行 @rendermode="InteractiveServer" 改为 @rendermode="InteractiveAuto"</p>
